desc: Built for everyday work without stretching your budget, the Maneuver delivers dependable performance with Kershaw's easy-to-use DuraLock. The drop point blade, crafted from easy-to-sharpen 8Cr13MoV steel with a stonewashed finish, tackles tough cutting tasks while hiding everyday wear. A dark bronze, textured glass-filled nylon handle provides a secure grip, while the integrated finger choil adds control, even with gloves. Slightly larger than slim EDC folders yet still thin enough for comfortable pocket carry, the Maneuver balances strength, reliability, and practicality. From jobsite tasks to everyday use, this hardworking folder offers solid performance at a price users will appreciate.
